description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

features.name: Expertise
features.tldr: Choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill and thieves' tools) to double your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.tldr: Deal extra damage to a creature you hit with advantage or when an ally is within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.tldr: Know a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in normal conversation.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.tldr: Quickly dart around the battlefield by using Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.tldr: Choose an archetype that defines your criminal or specialized specialty.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.tldr: Use your reaction to halve the damage an attacker deals to you when you can see them.

features.name: Expertise (Additional)
features.tldr: Choose two more skill proficiencies to double your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Evasion
features.tldr: You can deftly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, taking no damage on a successful save and half on a failure.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Roguish Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.tldr: Refine your skills so that any ability check using your proficiency lets you treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature

features.name: Blindsense
features.tldr: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.tldr: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature
features.tldr: Gain the capstone feature granted by your chosen Roguish Archetype.

features.name: Elusive
features.tldr: You are so evasive that attackers never gain advantage on attack rolls against you unless you are incapacitated.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.tldr: Turn a missed attack into a hit, or treat a failed ability check as a natural 20 once per rest.
